## 2. Engineering Disciplines & Technical Services

### 2.1 Web Application Development
- **Canonical URL**: https://varunyatech.com/services/web-development
- **Delivery SLA**: 30 Days
- **Key Capabilities**: Next.js 14/15 App Router architecture, Server Components (RSC), Edge API routing, TypeScript strict mode, responsive fluid layouts, Sub-second Core Web Vitals (LCP < 1.2s, FID < 50ms, CLS < 0.05).
- **Security & Reliability**: CSRF protection, Content Security Policies (CSP), sanitization, automated Lighthouse CI checks.

### 2.2 Custom Software Development
- **Canonical URL**: https://varunyatech.com/services/custom-software

## 3. Industry Verticals & Architectural Blueprints

1. **Education & Learning Platforms** (`https://varunyatech.com/industries/education`):
   - Features: Gamified practice modules, interactive abacus calculation grids, student progress tracking, educator grading dashboards.
2. **Healthcare & Medical Tech** (`https://varunyatech.com/industries/healthcare`):
   - Features: HIPAA-conscious data isolation, secure patient scheduling, teleconsultation portals, laboratory results integration.
3. **FinTech & Financial Architecture** (`https://varunyatech.com/industries/finance`):
   - Features: Double-entry accounting ledgers, PCI-DSS compliant payment gateway integrations, automated multi-currency invoicing, compliance audit trails.
4. **Retail & E-Commerce** (`https://varunyatech.com/industries/retail`):
   - Features: Sub-second headless storefronts, real-time inventory management, checkout funnel optimization, automated order dispatch.
5. **Logistics & Fleet Operations** (`https://varunyatech.com/industries/logistics`):
   - Features: GPS telematics visualization, dispatch scheduling, driver mobile interfaces, automated bill-of-lading generation.
6. **Real Estate & Property Portals** (`https://varunyatech.com/industries/real-estate`):
   - Features: MLS/IDX syndication, geo-spatial map search, automated lead routing, property valuation calculators.
7. **Manufacturing Systems** (`https://varunyatech.com/industries/manufacturing`):
   - Features: Factory floor telemetry, machine uptime tracking, batch QA verification, material resource planning.
8. **Construction & Infrastructure** (`https://varunyatech.com/industries/construction`):
   - Features: Subcontractor milestone approvals, blueprint version control, daily logs, safety inspection checklists.
9. **Hospitality & Booking Engines** (`https://varunyatech.com/industries/hospitality`):
   - Features: Direct booking engines, room rate yield management, automated guest messaging, point-of-sale integration.
10. **Government & Civic Portals** (`https://varunyatech.com/industries/government`):
    - Features: WCAG accessible citizen portals, identity verification, document filing workflows, encrypted public records.
